text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Sakura Bakushin O's
homeroom teacher
wants to talk to me
about her grades.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's a serious student, but her grades
are
lacking. I want to help her, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Dum dum da dum. ♪ In spring, the
dawn. ♪ In
summer, the night. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, well, if it isn't my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You recognized it! We studied it in
today's
class.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The passage describing the wonders of
the four
seasons really left a strong
impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It was such a powerful passage! The
impact made
me forget everything else
we read!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting things as soon as you learn
them
certainly makes it difficult to get a
good score on
tests. The best way to
help her improve would
be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might improve her grades if I raise
her
motivation and concentration
through praise and
encouragement...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Naturally!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As the class representative, I strive to
set an
example for everyone and
properly attend my
classes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Feel free to praise me more, if
you like!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the type of person who improves
with extra
praise!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, studying for tests! The hallmark of a
model
student such as I!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You mean to strike while the iron is hot!
Great
advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be off! I'll be going Bakushin,

BAKUSHIIIN on that test!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A high-spirited Sakura Bakushin O
departs with
an expression on her face
that exudes confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some days later...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I scored two points higher on the test
this time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My score rose from two to four! That's
double!
DOUBLE!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Turns out studying for tests really
is super
important!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll Bakushin along the path of the
model
student!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was only one small step, but there's no
doubt it
led to her getting a higher
score.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and I share a moment
of
excitement over her grades improving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I provide her with future opportunities
to talk
about her classes, it'd make for
good review.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to focus on her interests so she
won't forget
the things she learned...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good question!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If it were me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin in the spring! Running along
the cherry
tree-lined roads as their
blossoms flutter down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin in the summer! Running under
the
blazing sun is great too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin in the fall! Running through the

mountains while admiring the colorful
autumn
leaves!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin in the winter! Running in the
snow with
more vigor than a wolf!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...That's about it! What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Weeell?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! That it is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The day I am known as the Sei Shonagon
of
Tracen Academy might not be so far
off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I get super famous, I'll be in high
demand no
matter the race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it at least seems she hasn't
lost
interest in The Pillow Book.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's move on to questions that will
likely appear
on the test...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Just imagining the scenery makes
me want
to run so bad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's get an early start on today's
training! We
begin now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the words barely out of her mouth,
Sakura
Bakushin O dashes off at full
speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: WOOO!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
SPRING! SUMMER! FALL! WINTER!
BAKUSHIN
ALL YEAR ROUND!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing how she puts all her energy
into
everything she does. The one issue
is her lack of
persistence and
composure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let her homeroom teacher know that
keeping
these factors in mind is essential
for improving
her performance.
